description: License compliance policy for ThemisDB - defines acceptable and restricted licenses

project.name: ThemisDB
project.purpose: Multi-model database with native LLM integration for public sector digital sovereignty

copyleft-strong.reason: Strong copyleft - requires derivative works to be GPL licensed

copyleft-weak.reason: Weak copyleft - requires modifications to be released under same license
exceptions: RocksDB uses dual Apache-2.0/GPL-2.0 license - we use under Apache-2.0
Some system libraries may use LGPL - acceptable for dynamic linking

proprietary.reason: Proprietary or no clear open source license

unknown.reason: License not recognized — not in allowed list; manual review required before merge

compliance.review_process: All new dependencies must pass license compliance check before merge
